description:
Short title
monthly EM trend report by LLM

What should the AI do?
Every month someone in micro spends 2 days on the EM trend report. We want an LLM to pull the data from LIMS, write the narrative and the conclusions, and e-mail the finished report to QA and the area owners automatically as the monthly trend report

Where will it be used?
QC laboratory, QA / quality systems

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
No, only indirectly. its just the trend report

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM)

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used. QA gets it

Who checks the output, and how?
QA and the area owners receive it

What data goes into it?
Confidential company data
